payload.claim: The `Pooled` docstring says 'The probe check narrows a group before it pools one,' describing the only known cause of `group` holding a strict subset of a `FollowUpGroup`'s findings. This diff adds a second narrowing path, the ownership check, which also splits a group down to a single finding before pooling it (saffron/follow_up.py:417-427), but the docstring was not updated to mention it, leaving a reader of this class unaware of the second cause.
